properties.description: A withdrawn Decision contradicting its successor is not reported as a defect (crates/reflow2-core/tests/heal.rs) — 5 cases. THE CASE: a `rejected` Decision linked by CONTRADICTS to what replaced it is the HEALTHY shape — tried in thought, refuted, here is what we did instead — and reporting it as a warning made recording a refutation CORRECTLY cost a defect while burying it in prose cost nothing. `superseded` is pinned as the same shape by a different route. TWO COUNTERWEIGHTS, and they are what stop the fix becoming a hole: two ACCEPTED decisions that contradict each other are still reported, because a live disagreement is the whole reason the detector exists and trading a false positive for a false negative is strictly the worse bug; and `proposed` is NOT treated as withdrawn, because undecided is not abandoned and silencing it would hide exactly the disagreements a brainstorm exists to surface. The sibling `alignment: supporting` rule is pinned separately so the two skips cannot be collapsed into one.
properties.findings: MUTATION-CHECKED TWICE: removing the status check fails only the two withdrawn cases; widening it to "anything not accepted" fails ONLY the proposed counterweight, which is the case proving it does not silence too much. MEASURED ON THE REAL DESIGN: 16 defects and 4 contradictions before and after — reflow2 holds 10 superseded and 1 rejected Decision and ZERO CONTRADICTS edges from any of them, so nothing here was silenced.
properties.name: A withdrawn Decision contradicting its successor is not a defect
